survival.title: Survival Mode
survival.lede: Survive 30 days in a flooded barangay with your team. Build a boat, signal the rescue helicopter, and learn real flood safety along the way.
survival.noRuns: No games yet. Start a new game or join your friends with a code.
survival.leaveBody: Your bag goes into the camp storage for your team. You can't come back to this game.
survival.runsLimit: You can have up to {max} unfinished games at a time.
survival.disabled: Survival Mode is temporarily off. Please check back later.
survival.notEligible: Survival Mode is for players only.
survival.unavailable: The game server isn't reachable right now. Please try again in a moment.

difficultyHint.easy: Longer days, more supplies, you keep your bag if you fall.
difficultyHint.normal: The full experience. Your bag drops where you fall.
difficultyHint.hard: Fewer supplies, more storms, and no second chances.

modeHint.solo: Play alone with every team skill at half strength. You can pause.
modeHint.coop: 2–5 players. Share a room code with your friends or classmates.

endingBody.full_rescue: Everyone made it to the helicopter. You're safe!
endingBody.partial_rescue: Some of you were rescued. Next time, no one gets left behind.
endingBody.failed: The team wasn't rescued this time. Learn from it and try again.

joinPage.title: Join a team
joinPage.lede: Type the 6-character code your host shared, or open their invite link.

errors.not_eligible: Survival Mode is for players only.
errors.unavailable: The game server isn't reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_member: You're not part of this team.
errors.code_not_found: No game found with that code. Check it and try again.
errors.too_many_wrong_codes: Too many wrong codes. Please wait 15 minutes.
errors.too_many_runs: You already have 3 unfinished games. Finish or leave one first.
errors.outdated_client: A new version is available. Please reload the page.
errors.rate_limited: Slow down a little and try again.
errors.kicked: You were removed from this game.
errors.lobby_idle: The lobby closed because nobody was active.
errors.eligibility_lost: You can't play Survival Mode right now.
errors.duplicate_session: You're already in this game on another tab or device.
errors.rested: Rest time! Your game is saved — continue any time.
errors.server_restarting: The server is restarting. Your game is saved — continue in a moment.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.shareText: Join my Baha Ready Survival team! Code: {code}
lobby.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start…

reason.not_enough_players: You need at least 2 players for a team game.

roleHint.builder: Builds and crafts faster, uses fewer nails and rope.
roleHint.scout: Swims faster and spots supplies from farther.
roleHint.cook: Cooked food fills you up more.
roleHint.radio: Hears storm warnings and supply drops early.
roleHint.solo: Every team skill at half strength.

cutscene.p1: Signal No. 4. The rain hasn't stopped for three days.
cutscene.p2: Overnight, the lake rose and swallowed the streets of our barangay.
cutscene.p3: We climbed onto the rooftops. The phone lines are down.
cutscene.p4: The radio says: a rescue helicopter will come in 30 days.
cutscene.p5: We need clean water, food, a boat, and a way to be seen.

hud.downed: You're down! A teammate can help you up.
hud.dead: You fell. You'll be back at camp at dawn.

bag.title: Bag
bag.heavy: Heavy bag — you move slower and can't swim when over the limit.

storage.title: Camp storage
storage.onlyAtCamp: Go back to camp to use the storage.

denied.no_lakas: No energy — rest or eat first.
denied.self_only: Only medical items can be used on others.
denied.nothing_to_deposit: You don't have the needed materials.
denied.needs_bandage: You need a bandage or first-aid kit.
denied.needs_teammate: Only a teammate can help you up.
denied.needs_food_or_water: Bring food or clean water to help them.
denied.cannot_sleep: Sleep at camp, at night, in a shelter (not during storms).
denied.too_early: Not yet — wait for the rescue day.
denied.no_signal_fire: Build the signal fire pile first.
denied.no_one_to_signal: Signal from the rescue point when the helicopter comes.
denied.changed: That item is no longer there.

event.phase_night: Night has fallen. Stay warm and stay near camp.
event.phase_day: Morning. Time to search for supplies.
event.storm_started: A storm is here! The water is rising.
event.second_wind: {name} got back up. Second Winds left: {left}
event.all_down: Everyone fell. You'll wake at camp at dawn — some boat work was lost.
event.supply_incoming: Radio: a supply drop is coming soon. Check the map!
event.supply_drop: A supply crate dropped! Check the map.
event.survivor_spotted: Someone is stranded on a rooftop! Check the map.
event.survivor_following: A survivor is following {name} to camp.
event.survivor_evacuated: A stranded survivor was taken away by others.
event.storm_damage_boat: The storm damaged the boat. Cover the build site with a tarp!
event.storm_damage_storage: The storm ruined {lost} stored materials. Cover the storage!
event.debris_arrived: Floating debris drifted in after the storm.
event.heli_incoming: The rescue helicopter is on its way! Get to the rescue point and signal.
event.boat_departed: The boat has left for the rescue point!
event.rest_scheduled: Rest vote passed: the game saves and ends at dawn.
event.rest_ended_session: Rest time! See you next session.
event.shutdown_warning: Survival Mode is being paused. The game saves and closes in {minutes} minutes.
event.shutdown_cancelled: Never mind — Survival Mode stays on.

hazard.live_wire: Sparks! Live wires — stay out of this water.
hazard.collapse: The building is shaking — get out!
hazard.snake: Something is moving in the grass.

chat.title: Team chat
chat.off: Chat is off in your settings.
chat.quickOnly: Only quick chat is on in your settings.
chat.reported: Thanks — an admin will review it.
chat.reportFailed: Couldn't send the report. Try again.

rejected.personal_info: For everyone's safety, personal info, links and contact requests can't be shared in chat.
rejected.restricted: Your chat is turned off by an admin. Quick chat still works.
rejected.chat_off_for_you: Turn on chat in Settings to send messages.

chat.blocked: Blocked. You won't be placed together again.

vote.everyoneAtCamp: Everyone must be at camp to rest.

results.tipsUnlocked: Related safety tips were added to your Tips Library.

board.title: Survival leaderboard
board.empty: No finished games yet. Be the first!

settings.title: Survival Mode
settings.chatHint: Chat is only with your teammates in the same game. Messages are filtered and kept for 14 days for safety.

teaser.title: New: Survival Mode
teaser.body: Team up with up to 5 friends and survive 30 days in a flooded barangay. Sign up to play.
teaser.card: Survive 30 days with your team. Build a boat and get rescued!

survival.rotate: Turn your phone sideways for the best view.

toastMsg.survivor_gift: The survivor gave you something as thanks!
toastMsg.server_restarting: The server is restarting — your game is saved.
toastMsg.role_changed: Your role changed — you can finish this session, but you can't start or join new Survival games.
